subsystem.name: VehicleAIPitControl
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame AI driver control and pit-stop decision logic for race vehicles: AI tick orchestration (pre-race init vs racing path), waypoint/racing-line following, steering-target computation and lane scoring, driver-status state machine, AI ability drift, and tire-compound pit-stop scheduling with retirement.

source_proposals.summary: The vehicle AI subsystem drives one race vehicle per frame. AIMainUpdate (0x00424E70) is the tick orchestrator: it gates on aiEnableFlag, runs a pre-race/formation init branch and a racing branch, and commits control outputs into the vehicle input fields (0x3580/0x3584/0x357C). AIDriverStructInit (0x00424790) reinitialises the per-vehicle AI field block. The racing path delegates to AIWaypointSteeringUpdate (0x00426430), AIRacingLine (0x00425920), computeSteeringTarget (0x004270A0) and a driverStatus state machine (0..7) that dispatches SteeringAngleController (0x00425670) and related sub-functions. updateAIAbility (0x00429470) drifts the driver ability value and drives pit-stop decisions; PitStopDecisionTireCompound (0x0042A3D0) schedules tire compounds and can retire the vehicle. AISteeringRacingLineCorrection (0x0042B0E0) adjusts steering against the racing line. Two UNKNOWN-owner dispatch helpers (0x00409F40, 0x0040B360) perform chained vtable dispatch.

function_roles.role: Chained vtable dispatch helper: calls slot vtable+0x18 on this, then slot +0x1C on the non-null result and returns the second result, else the first.
Chained virtual dispatch helper: calls slot vtable+24 on this, then slot +28 on the non-null result, else returns the first result.

Per-frame AI driver subsystem reinitialization: clears AI state flags/timers/counters, seeds waypoint sentinels, resets pace/grip/pit/speed defaults, optionally reloads waypoint data and command-queue buffers.

Per-frame AI tick orchestrator: entry gate on AIEnableFlag, pre-race/formation init path, and racing path (heading vectors, driveability gate, lap-push, AIAbility refresh, pit entry/exit transitions, driverStatus 0..7 dispatch).
AI steering-angle and driver-status controller: follow-target steering (state 6) vs direction-vector steering, steering-error accumulator, position-snapshot timer toggling states 6/0.

AI racing-line and speed-profile update: waypoint chain resolution, lead-car aero drag, tire-force energy-decay speed profile, overtaking threat scoring, throttle/brake targets and overtaking-window flag.

AI waypoint-following and steering update: speed magnitude, waypoint re-query on drift, 20-node look-ahead chain rebuild, pit-lane entry command dispatch, tire-force grip solve, 0..3 speed zone, boundary-clamped steering targets.
AI steering-target computation: 5-lane boundary scan, centre steering, lane scoring via spatial queries, overtaking state transitions and session-time steering overrides.

Per-frame AI ability/driver tick: engagement-mode selection, difficulty scaling, per-frame ability drift and probability override, steering-target recompute, pit-stop decision logic (pit exit, tire-compound duration, fuel-weight pit exit).
Per-frame AI pit-stop logic: tire-compound selection vs lap count and session state, wing-repair lap records re-arm, vehicle retirement on blocking condition.
AI steering correction relative to the racing line: reference-opponent scan in race phase, wrapped-distance track parameter, overtaking/timing decisions and rotation-matrix steering recompute.

class_proposals.name: F1CVehicle
class_proposals.responsibility: Race vehicle: the AI field block (this base, roughly +0x4000..+0x461C) plus the shared vehicle fields (position, velocity, heading, gear, engine RPM, fuel, car conditions) that the AI tick reads and writes. The obj base is the vehicle root reached via this+0x0.

class_proposals.name: WaypointNode
class_proposals.responsibility: Waypoint-graph node reached through the vehicle pointer fields (0x4354 current, 0x4358 chain base, 0x4364 third chain node, 0x4400 lead reference, forward-link at +0x114). Holds position, tangent, up-vector, track distance, lateral boundaries, grip/traction, heading and node-id/pit-entry flag.

class_proposals.name: RacingLineSteeringController
class_proposals.responsibility: Per-frame AI steering-target computation: 5-lane boundary scan, centre-steering computation, lane scoring via spatial nearest-neighbour queries, and overtaking state transitions on the vehicle.

state_machines.name: DriverStatusMachine
transitions: pit-wait timer 0x4170 < now -> driverStatus = 4 (session type 0x7C56A4==7) else 5, then re-arm pit-exit timer 0x447C
0/6 -> SteeringAngleController (0x425670); 6 -> 7 when |heading error| < 0.5 or 0x447C elapsed
0x447C snapshot timer -> toggle 6/0 and snapshot position into 0x4470/0x4474/0x4478
1 -> sub_4258C0; 2 -> FieldZeroSetter and return; 3 -> waypoint squared-distance vs 0x461C -> 0 when farther, else update 0x461C
steering-error accumulator 0x446C > 0x4558 -> driverStatus = 1 (after RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate when gear 0x39FC > 2)
7 -> zero 0x442C/0x4438/0x4434; Speed 0x4440 < 0.2 -> driverStatus = 0
racing-line reset path -> driverStatus = 4/5 by 0x7C56A4; pit-return 5 -> 3 after tier selection or -> 0

state_machines.name: PitStopDecisionMachine
transitions: PitStopBlockingCondition or session != 7 -> not service-ready; when session==7 set RetiredFlag 0x4410=1, clear AIControlFlag 0x45F4, log via sub_4BC060
service-ready path -> tire-compound tier selection and SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror + PostPitCleanup

interfaces.name: SpatialWaypointQuery
interfaces.purpose: Nearest-neighbour, plane-test and indexed-field copy queries over the shared waypoint spatial tree (dword_5EA2C0) used by racing-line, waypoint-following and steering.

interfaces.name: AICommandQueue
interfaces.purpose: AI command-message queue: dispatch of pit-lane/waypoint-set commands (message id 14) and ring-buffer input selection for the AI tick.

compatibility_contracts.name: ControlOutputCommitContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Every AI tick path must write committed control outputs into the input fields this+0x3580 (throttle), this+0x3584 (brake), this+0x357C (steering) before returning; the racing fallthrough writes neutral (0, 1.0, 0). A replacement executable must preserve this commit location and neutrality.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverStatusContract
compatibility_contracts.description: driverStatus at this+0x4510 must keep the documented 0..7 semantics: pit entry forces 4 or 5 (session type 0x7C56A4==7 selects 4), 6 is follow-target steering, 7 stops the car until Speed<0.2, and the racing-line reset forces 4/5 by the same session-type rule.

compatibility_contracts.description: Global session type dword_7C56A4 and phase dword_7C56A8 select the driver-status pit values, the countdown/launch ramp (dword_5C30E0 / dword_5C3144 tables, global byte_5C3160), the ability drift, and the retirement path; simulation time dbl_8AFEA0 is the shared clock for all timers.

compatibility_contracts.description: Retirement sets RetiredFlag at this+0x4410 and clears AIControlFlag at this+0x45F4, then logs through sub_4BC060; AIDriverStructInit clears both when a session (re)starts.

subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPit
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame AI decision-making for vehicles and pit-stop strategy/timing: difficulty scaling, steering and racing-line correction, AI command queueing, pit-entry/exit forcing, fuel and tire strategy, driver-table event reporting, per-vehicle tire physics, and the fixed-tick main loop that drives them.

source_proposals.summary: Conservative DERIVED proposal for the vehicle-AI and pit subsystem. A per-vehicle AI state (F1CVehicle) carrying steering, command-queue, pit, fuel and tire fields is driven by a fixed 400-tick main loop (0x0042C690) that dispatches AI, physics, particle and wear subsystems on tick parity/modulo windows. Difficulty scaling is a small interpolation curve over the slider global. Pit strategy spans fuel-sufficiency checks, pit-entry forcing (ForcePitExit / SetCallToBox), a deduplicated command queue, post-pit cleanup, and a pit-stop part-state copy with scoring intervals. Tire physics is split into per-wheel compound application and per-vehicle model initialization. Owners marked CONFIRMED by the packet are the only members of the F1CVehicle class; every other function keeps the packet's owner or a DERIVED legacy-ABI lead.

function_roles.role: Guarded scene-object/widget cleanup chain on an ID field: helper subroutine, arithmetic comparison, and cleanup subroutine; early-returns uninitialized when this+0x0 == -1.

AI retirement / vehicle-failure session event handler; gated to the player's team and race session; inserts driver-table entries (types 41, 1, 2, 273, 272) using lap-time gap calculation and ftol truncation.

AI pit-strategy event handler restricted to the player vehicle; branches on pitting status to emit event type 42/52 into the session event table via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and InsertDriverTableEntry.
AI difficulty slider to scalar mapper; returns flat 1.0 at slider >= 95, otherwise a linear ramp from roughly 0.75 to below 1.0.
AI difficulty curve interpolation between low/mid/high anchor constants (flt_5EA3DC / flt_5EA3E0 / flt_5EA3E4); slider > 100 interpolates mid-to-high, otherwise low-to-mid.
Per-frame AI ring-buffer noise field update; writes this+0x4448 from a trig lookup plus baseline minus a difficulty-scaled term; invoked by CameraViewportFrustumInitialization and AIMainUpdate.
AI command message queue dispatcher; switch on command id for state transitions (4, 5, 1, 15), race-phase cleanup, and a deduplicated {command,value} queue with capacity and idle handling.
Per-frame AI steering blend, grip-degradation/decay, and racing-line correction applied to per-vehicle steering state; clamps against track-segment or difficulty-scaled limits.
Per-frame AI pit-entry trigger; when the fuel multiplier drops below 1 during the pit-window phase and no pit stop is already requested, forces a pit exit.
AI pit-state forcing / pit-entry request on a vehicle; race-session gated on last lap, teammate part value, and finish state; runs pit-controller actions and returns AIStateFlagSetter(1).

Per-frame AI push-lap strategy for the player vehicle; adjusts target lap time, writes a performance scalar, selects a recommended tire compound against track-grip bands, and forces a pit exit on mismatch or low average tire wear.
Post-pit-exit cleanup; sentinel slot fill, tire-change flag read and counter increment, session-gated time-of-next-exit clear, and next-exit timestamp scheduling.
AI passing/overtake score computation; first solves opponent tire forces, then combines an input term with AI weight and scaling fields and an opponent factor.
Sets the vehicle AI call-to-box flag (+0x454C) to 0 or 1; values greater than 1 are silently ignored; returns the input unchanged.
Fuel multiplier computation; returns floor(fuelRateFactor * theoreticalLapsPerLitre - 0.2) via ftol when the FuelMult flag is set, otherwise the default value 100.

AI pit-strategy fuel sufficiency check; returns TRUE immediately when the FuelMult check is disabled, otherwise compares remaining laps (reduced by a stint factor) against a fuel-consumption estimate.
Zeroes a 0x50-byte per-instance AI state-flag block at this+17236 and returns 0; called from AI and race-struct initialization paths.
Per-frame pit-blocked check; race path ORs lap/phase/byte/rear-wing-damage terms, non-race path returns bit 8 of an indexed pit-schedule slot.

Per-frame main game tick; fixed tick loop dispatching AI, physics, particle, fuel/wear and tire-force subsystems on tick parity and modulo windows; wraps the tick counter at 400 and returns the per-vehicle camera iterator result.
Branch-free delegate on the frame path; forwards a selector field and a sub-struct to WeightedDataLookup.

Per-wheel tire compound physics application; resolves the compound record, populates a per-wheel physics record, resolves slip-curve names, runs force/interpolation helpers, and writes the suspension-ratio output at this+0xAC.

Per-vehicle tire physics model initialization; FPU control-word save/restore, step and traction constants from 400 >> dword_7CE958, HDV file parsing, body-name mapping, physics init, brake-bias setup, and temp-buffer cleanup.

Pit-stop part-state copy from a source vehicle state into the pit-stop struct; bulk part data, tire brand/compound resolution, scoring interval computation, session compound override, callback chains, and return of PitstopStateTransition.

class_proposals.name: F1CVehicle

class_proposals.name: PitStrategy

class_proposals.name: AI_Push_Lap_Closing_Gap

class_proposals.name: Pit_Part_State_Copy

class_proposals.name: TirePhysicsModel
class_proposals.responsibility: Per-vehicle tire physics model built from HDV data and applied per wheel; the two tire functions in this packet operate on the same this base and share the compound-index, step and context-handle offsets.

state_machines.name: AIPitStateMachine
transitions: Idle -> PitRequested: AI command id 1 schedules the pit decision timer (this+0x413C = session time + 2.0)
PitRequested -> PitLaneActive: AI command id 4 enables the pit state via sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 1)
PitLaneActive -> Idle: AI command id 5 clears this+0x4548 and disables the pit state via sub_4A46F0(this, 0, 0)
Idle -> PitRequested: pit-window phase (dword_7C56A8 == 5) with a sub-1 fuel multiplier forces a pit exit (ForcePitExit)
Any -> Blocked: last-lap, teammate-part, or finish-state guard blocks ForcePitExit
Any -> Blocked: race phase dword_7C56A8 == 8 blocks pit requests (PitStopBlockingCondition)

state_machines.name: AICommandQueue
transitions: Idle -> Pending: append an 8-byte {command, value} entry at +0x44A8 and store the new index at +0x44B0
Pending -> Pending: re-send the queued response when the command is already present (dedup scan)
Pending -> Idle: after CommandQueueResponseHandler (0x00429EE0), the index at +0x44B0 resets to -1
Pending -> Full: append denied when index + 1 reaches capacity +0x44AC; the index is restored to its previous value

interfaces.name: PitEntryRequest
interfaces.purpose: Request an AI pit entry by setting the call-to-box flag or forcing pit state, gated by race-session, fuel, and wear conditions.

interfaces.name: DifficultyScaling
interfaces.purpose: Map the AI difficulty slider global onto an AI ability scalar, either as a flat capped value or an anchored interpolation.

interfaces.name: DriverEventReporting
interfaces.purpose: Emit driver-table events (retirement, failure, pit) into the session event table anchored at flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry.

interfaces.name: TireCompoundPhysics
interfaces.purpose: Initialize and apply the per-vehicle/per-wheel tire compound physics model from HDV data.

compatibility_contracts.name: AIPitDecisionTimer
compatibility_contracts.description: AI command id 1 writes vehicle+0x413C to session time (dbl_8AFEA0) + 2.0, scheduling the pit decision timer.

compatibility_contracts.name: AICommandQueueLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The AI command queue stores 8-byte {command, value} entries in the buffer at +0x44A8 with capacity at +0x44AC and index at +0x44B0; already-pending commands are deduplicated by re-sending the queued response, and a full queue restores the prior index instead of overwriting.

compatibility_contracts.name: MainTick400
compatibility_contracts.description: The main game tick converts session time (dbl_8AFEA0 * 400) to a tick count; the tick counter dword_7C5698 wraps at 400 and dword_7C5694 is clamped so the pending tick delta never exceeds 201.

compatibility_contracts.name: TractionModeShift
compatibility_contracts.description: The tire model step is derived as 400 >> dword_7CE958 and its traction constants are published to the globals dbl_5E5238 and dbl_5E5240; consumers outside this packet depend on those globals.

subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPitOperations
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle-side AI and pit operations: pit-machine state machine (pit-box alignment, pit-stop readiness, per-frame pit-stop progress with speed limiter and wheel-force ramps), racing-line/path following with target-node traversal, tire physics force computation (sign-selected lookup tables, friction-circle model, wear simulation), tire brand catalog lookup, and AI opponent roster selection.

source_proposals.summary: The packet groups 18 validated functions into two well-bounded regions. (1) A pit-machine cluster (owner CONFIRMED F1CPitMachine for 0x004A5D10/0x004A5FA0/0x004A6200/0x004A68B0): a mode-byte dispatcher reading a vehicle sub-state at obj+0x32C8 and routing through optional delegate objects, a pit-box alignment projection test, a pit-stop readiness evaluation with a speed limiter and camera mode forcing, and a per-frame progress tick that ramps wheel forces, deactivates the limiter, clears AI reason code 9, and notifies state 4 on exit. (2) Tire-physics and vehicle-AI helpers sharing a large float-table-bearing object (mode selector this+0x39B4, contact-patch array this+0x39D0, force tables +0x3C40/+0x3C80, wear slots +0x3D64..0x3D70): grip coefficient, force solvers, wheel/suspension init, engine-wear simulation, racing-line path traversal and path-position tracking, plus a tire-brand table lookup and an AI opponent roster builder. Owners of the tire/physics functions are UNKNOWN in the packet; the shared-field class grouping is DERIVED. All trust is DERIVED/GUESS per worker policy; no new CONFIRMED facts are claimed.

function_roles.role: Pit-machine main AI state dispatcher: stores event mode/value, routes to pit strategy, crew, and delegate sub-objects on mode and vehicle sub-state.
Pit-box alignment readiness test: projection of the relative vehicle-to-target vector against the target rotation basis plus velocity/slip thresholds.
Pit-stop readiness evaluation: wheel-spin gate, camera mode 1, tire-compound decision, pit timer arming and player pit-mid arming.

Per-frame pit-stop progress: wheel-force ramps and speed-limiter ramp while servicing, then pit-exit sequence (limiter deactivation, AI reason clear, state-4 notify, elapsed computation, audio, cleanup).
Builds a performance-ranked, deduplicated AI opponent list with float-key merge sort.
Tire brand name lookup over a 36-byte-stride table, with gated not-found debug logging.
Per-wheel suspension/tire state initialization: wheel offset from chassis origin, suspension parameters, rotation matrix and Euler extraction.
Physics tire system constructor: sub-structure initializers, defaults (this+0x32BC = -1, this+0x39A4 = 0) and post-constructor finalization.
Per-corner tire grip coefficient with anti-roll cross-coupling, mode-selected by this+0x39B4 and clamped to [0,1].
Bisection root solver for a tire contact-force function over sign-selected lookup tables.
Tire force via friction-circle model: sign-selected table interpolation, aero-drag term, clamp and slip-velocity drag return.
Lateral tire grip force with contact-patch capacity accumulation and aero table term.
AI racing-line path traversal: node lookup and chain walk to the target node id, vehicle state copy, suspension/wheel-contact updates, display-node toggles.
Engine wear simulation: FLT_MAX wear-slot init and per-frame noise-driven recomputation gated by dword_7CEA5C in (0,2].
AI vehicle path-position tracking: orientation copy, rotation matrix build, ride-height error accumulation, rigid-body constraint solve.
Conditional tire-scrub reset gated by wear mode; clamps scrub slot +0x3D64 or global dbl_7C91DC.
Audio pitch and wheel-RPM scaling by the speed ratio, flag-gated by byte_7D01C4, then tire brush model solve.
Tire force/torque from a bias-scaled quadratic model gated by enable byte this+0x1EC.

class_proposals.name: F1CPitMachine
class_proposals.responsibility: Owns the pit-stop lifecycle: mode dispatch from event records, pit-box alignment checks, readiness evaluation, per-frame progress/servicing and pit-exit sequencing.

class_proposals.responsibility: AI racing-line path following and per-frame path-position tracking: node chain traversal, target node resolution, orientation/position state, suspension and wheel-contact updates, rigid-body constraint solving.
